page.overview:
Who is Iphitus?

Iphitus was among the heroes who assembled to form the crew of the Argo. Other than that not much is known about what happened to Iphitus.

Clytius and Iphitus, sons of Eurytus and Antiope, daughter of Pylo, kings of Oechalia. Category:Argonauts
